# unifi_device_port_override (Resource)

Manage the settings of one switch port (an entry of the device's legacy `port_overrides`): its name, native network and tagged networks. Only this port's entry changes; the device's other ports and this port's unmodelled settings (PoE, STP, port security, rate limits, ...) are kept as the controller has them. Attributes left unset keep the controller's value. Import with `<site_id>/<device_mac>/<port_idx>`. Destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state: the port keeps its settings, because resetting a port to its defaults moves whatever is plugged into it to the default network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_site" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

data "unifi_network" "family" {
  site_id = data.unifi_site.default.id
  name    = "Family"
}

# A printer on port 2 of a small switch: Family untagged, no tagged networks.
resource "unifi_device_port_override" "printer" {
  site_id           = data.unifi_site.default.id
  device_mac        = "0c:ea:14:00:00:01"
  port_idx          = 2
  name              = "Printer"
  native_network_id = data.unifi_network.family.id
  tagged_vlan_mgmt  = "block_all"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_mac` (String) MAC address of the switch in lower case, for example `0c:ea:14:00:00:01`.
- `port_idx` (Number) Port number as the controller counts it, starting at 1.
- `site_id` (String) Integration site UUID.

### Optional

- `excluded_network_ids` (Set of String) With `tagged_vlan_mgmt = "custom"`: networks not carried tagged, as integration network IDs.
- `name` (String) Port name shown in the UI.
- `native_network_id` (String) Network carried untagged on the port, as an integration network ID (`unifi_network.<name>.id`). The provider translates it to the legacy networkconf ID.
- `tagged_vlan_mgmt` (String) Tagged networks: `auto` (all), `block_all` (none, native only) or `custom` (all except `excluded_network_ids`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<site_id>/<device_mac>/<port_idx>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the integration site UUID, the switch MAC and the port number.
terraform import unifi_device_port_override.printer <site_id>/0c:ea:14:00:00:01/2
```
